name: twd-module-federation
description: Module Federation POC: one page, three microfrontends (Vue 3, React 17 legacy API, React 19)

scripts.build: npm run build -w mfe-react-modern && npm run build -w mfe-react-legacy && npm run build -w mfe-vue && npm run build -w host
scripts.test: npm run test -w mfe-react-modern && npm run test -w mfe-react-legacy && npm run test -w mfe-vue
